purpose: Disambiguate the three independent status axes recorded in campaign_manifest.json phase_status, so FINAL_* labels on post-block phases are not misread as advancement.

axes.ADVANCEMENT_STATUS: Gate outcome for role progression: PASS/ADVANCE, DO_NOT_ADVANCE, NOT_REACHED. Authoritative source: frozen contract advance_if evaluated mechanically. Only Phase 3 and Phase 4 issue gate decisions in this campaign.
axes.CHARACTERIZATION_STATUS: Completeness/quality of measurement work (evidence produced, invalidated runs documented, verdicts honest). Applies to every phase. A phase can be FINAL on this axis while ADVANCEMENT_STATUS is blocked — permitted by the pinned Early-Stop Philosophy note (Reliability FAIL -> 'classify limitations / potentially STOP'), ruling B in WELP-CONFORMANCE.md.
axes.ROLE_ELIGIBILITY: What roles the model may hold (Phase 10 classify.py output). Closed by the Phase-4 DO_NOT_ADVANCE: omp_local_agent NOT_REACHED; final roles=[]. No characterization result can reopen eligibility.

reliability.advancement: DO_NOT_ADVANCE (G6 1/21 FAIL, mechanical; scorer-lexicon artifacts documented via manual review but NOT applied per frozen gate-authority rule 5)
reliability.role_eligibility_effect: CLOSES omp_local_agent and any role requiring Phase-4 CLEAN_PASS

capability_modules.advancement: NONE ISSUED (all contracts CHARACTERIZATION_ONLY; decision-log D4: no honest thresholds at 4-control calibration)
capability_modules.role_eligibility_effect: cannot open roles; genuine failures recorded as model defects

invariants: No post-Phase-4 artifact is cited as grounds to soften, appeal, or reinterpret the Phase-4 DO_NOT_ADVANCE.
Manual-review reclassifications (MINOR_DEFECT) annotate scorer artifacts only; mechanical gate counts stand everywhere they are reported.
Invalidated runs are retained and labeled, never deleted (frozen campaign rule).
